f.n: Torngat Mountains National Park Of Canada
f.pu: To protect this Inuit homeland featuring jagged peaks and glacier-carved fjords plunges towards iceberg-dotted indigo waters.
f.re: Anyone entering the boundaries of the National Park, including all marine areas, requires authorization from Parks Canada.
